md_share_enable_help: Share the summoned demon to configured players.
md_share_friends_help: Friend names, comma separated. Searched in Friends first, then Cross-server.
md_only_summon_and_share_help: Only summon and share demons, never battle. One demon per run.
md_share_interval_help: Interval between runs in summon & share only mode. Default 5 minutes.
md_share_star_help: all=share 1-6 star; 1-4=share only 1-4 star; 5-6=share only 5/6 star. Default 5-6.
